Function ExcelSerialWithTime(dateTimeStr As String) As Double Dim baseDate As Date = datevalue("01/01/1900") Dim parsedDate As Date = Date.Parse(dateTimeStr) Dim span As TimeSpan = parsedDate - baseDate Return span.TotalDays + 1 ' +1 to match Excel's 1-based date system End Function
Function GetExactAge(dob As Date, calcDate As Date) As Double Dim days As Double = (calcDate - dob).TotalDays Dim age As Double = days / 365.2425 ' Average days in a year (accounts for leap years) Return age End Function
Function GetLastDateOfMonth(inDate As Date) As Double
Dim theLastDayOfMonth As Integer = DateTime.DaysInMonth(inDate.Year, inDate.Month) Dim theLastDateOfMonth As New DateTime(InDate.Year, inDate.Month, theLastDayOfMonth)
Return theLastDateOfMonth.ToOADate
End Function
